newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia merchandise imports rise in Dec.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia merchandise imports rise in Dec.

text.p: Australian merchandise imports rose one percent in December to A$6.453 billion seasonally adjusted from A$6.401 billion in November, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with seasonally adjusted imports of A$6.473 billion in December 1995.
In unadjusted terms, merchandise imports fell six percent to A$6.249 billion in December from A$6.641 billion in November and compared to A$5.941 billion in December 1995.
Economists had on average forecast a flat outcome for seasonally adjusted imports for December.
The bureau said seasonally adjusted imports of consumption goods rose one percent in December, while capital goods fell six percent and intermediate and other goods rose four percent.
It said that in original terms capital goods imports fell five percent. The largest decrease was recorded in civil aircraft, which fell A$75 million or 60 percent.
